Name: Asin
Description: Return the inverse sine (arcsin) of a number. The inverse sine of x is the angle in radians whose sine is equal to x .

Arguments.name: x
Arguments.description: Must be a real number between -1.0 and 1.0, inclusive

Returns: The inverse sine of x , in radians x
Exceptions: If x is not a number, or is less than -1.0 or greater than 1.0, an error value is returned x

Example.description: [Return the inverse sine of the value of 'att1' at 8am yesterday]
[Return the inverse sine of the value of 'att1' at trigger time]
